description: Semiconductor laser diode: a PN-junction emitter that lases above a threshold current, orderable as a single-emitter, a bar/stack, or a fiber-coupled module, and usually shipping with a back-facet monitor photodiode. Covers Fabry-Perot edge emitters (visible red, IR pump), single-frequency DFB/DBR sources (telecom 1310/1550 nm, atomic-reference 780 nm - narrow linewidth, high SMSR), VCSELs (850 nm datacom, 940 nm sensing/flood), and high-power multimode single-emitters and fiber-coupled modules. It reuses the diode/LED measurement envelope (forward voltage, wavelength, optical power, thermal) with a DISJOINT vocabulary - threshold current, slope efficiency, beam divergence, SMSR, linewidth, RIN, COD - plus an optional monitor-photodiode block. Out of scope as separate concerns: LEDs (the led family), photodiodes/phototransistors/APDs (receivers), optical transceiver modules and fiber (systems/passive), and laser-diode driver ICs. The integrated thermoelectric cooler (TEC) and thermistor of a pigtailed module are captured as an optional cooler block since they share the orderable MPN, but the driver IC never is. Synthesized from a 20-datasheet corpus across Thorlabs, Ushio, Eblana, LD-PD, ams-OSRAM, Broadcom, VI Systems, BWT, PAM-XIAMEN, Nichia/APS, and nLIGHT.

parameters.name: Threshold current
parameters.hint: The drive current at the onset of lasing (the extrapolated x-intercept of the light-versus-current curve), in amperes. Spans three decades by device class: ~0.5-1 mA for a datacom single-emitter VCSEL, ~15-70 mA for a red/IR Fabry-Perot, up to ~0.3-0.9 A for a high-power multi-junction or multimode emitter - so store the value at whatever magnitude the datasheet prints (mA normalized: 25 mA is 0.025). Rises with temperature; carry the case temperature as a T_C condition.

parameters.name: Operating current
parameters.hint: The forward drive current at the rated optical output power, in amperes (attach P_OUT and T_C conditions - it is always specified 'at Po = rated'). Distinct from the absolute-maximum forward-current rating (store that on forward_current with limitClass absolute_max).

parameters.name: Forward current (maximum)
parameters.hint: The absolute-maximum continuous forward current the die survives (limitClass absolute_max), in amperes. A pulsed maximum is higher - store it as a second measurement with PULSE_WIDTH and DUTY conditions. Exceeding it risks catastrophic optical damage (see optical_output_power's COD ceiling).

parameters.name: Operating (forward) voltage
parameters.hint: The forward voltage at the rated operating current, in volts (attach P_OUT / I_op). A single red/IR emitter runs ~2 V, a blue emitter ~4-5 V, a UV or stacked multi-emitter module tens of volts (a 6-bar stack ~22 V). Set limitClass absolute_max for a printed maximum forward-voltage rating.

parameters.name: Optical output power
parameters.hint: The optical (radiant) output power, in watts (mW normalized: 10 mW is 0.01; a pump/blue emitter is 1-140 W). Array over drive current (the light-versus-current curve). Two senses by limitClass, NOT separate keys: the rated/operating power (characterized, at I_op) and the maximum/COD ceiling above which the facet is destroyed (absolute_max - the 'catastrophic optical damage' limit, or a pulsed maximum with PULSE_WIDTH/DUTY). For a fiber-coupled part this is the chip/window power; the fiber-coupled figure, if distinct, goes in fiber_output_power.

parameters.name: Slope (differential) efficiency
parameters.hint: The slope of the light-versus-current curve above threshold - optical watts out per amp of drive current in, in W/A (a printed mW/mA is the identical number: 0.8 mW/mA is 0.8 W/A, no scale factor). ~0.3-0.5 W/A for a datacom VCSEL, ~0.6-1.3 W/A for a red/IR Fabry-Perot, ~2-11 W/A for a high-power emitter/stack. NOTE: some datasheets mislabel this as 'quantum efficiency' when the printed unit is mW/mA - it is slope efficiency, alias it here.

parameters.name: Power conversion (wall-plug) efficiency
parameters.hint: Optical output power as a percentage of input electrical power (Popt / (Vop x Iop) x 100). ~30-50 % for an efficient high-power pump; low for visible/short-wavelength parts. Store the printed percentage.

parameters.name: Reverse voltage (laser)
parameters.hint: The absolute-maximum reverse voltage across the laser junction (limitClass absolute_max), in volts (typically 2 V). A laser diode is not built to be reverse-biased. Distinct from the monitor photodiode's reverse bias (pd_reverse_voltage).

parameters.name: Differential (series) resistance
parameters.hint: The dynamic (series) resistance dV/dI above threshold, in ohms, at a stated current. Printed mainly on datacom parts (it sets the electrical match to the driver); a VCSEL is ~80-100 ohm.

parameters.name: Center (peak) wavelength
parameters.hint: The lasing wavelength, in metres (nm normalized: 1550 nm is 1.55e-6; 976 nm is 9.76e-7; 650 nm is 6.5e-7), at the rated operating point (attach I_op/P_OUT and T_C). A DFB/DBR part prints a tight tolerance (store as min/typ/max, e.g. 1310.0 +/- 0.5 nm); a Fabry-Perot a wide range. Shifts with temperature (wavelength_temperature_coefficient) and current (wavelength_current_coefficient).

parameters.name: Spectral width
parameters.hint: The width of the emission spectrum, in metres (nm normalized: 1 nm is 1e-9). A single-frequency DFB is <0.001 nm (report the coherent linewidth in Hz on the linewidth key instead), a Fabry-Perot ~1-3 nm, a free-running multimode pump ~6 nm. Carry the statistic (FWHM default, or rms - a VCSEL often prints RMS width) via the statistic field, and the drive/temperature point as conditions.

parameters.name: Optical linewidth
parameters.hint: The coherent optical linewidth of a single-frequency (DFB/DBR/ECL) laser, as a FREQUENCY width in hertz (kHz/MHz normalized: 400 kHz is 4e5, 3 MHz is 3e6) - NOT a wavelength width (use spectral_width in m for a multimode part). It sets coherence length; ultra-narrow-linewidth parts reach <1 kHz. Record the measurement method (self-heterodyne) and bias in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Side-mode suppression ratio
parameters.hint: The power ratio between the dominant longitudinal mode and the strongest side mode, in dB - the single-frequency-ness of a DFB/DBR (typically >30 dB min, 40 dB typ). High SMSR is what makes a source single-mode; a Fabry-Perot (multi-mode) does not specify it.

parameters.name: Wavelength temperature coefficient
parameters.hint: The shift of lasing wavelength with temperature, in m/degC (nm/degC or nm/K normalized - identical for a slope: 0.3 nm/degC is 3e-10 m/degC). Positive (emission red-shifts as the junction heats). ~0.06-0.07 nm/degC for a VCSEL, ~0.1 nm/degC for a DFB, ~0.2-0.3 nm/degC for an edge-emitter; a VBG-wavelength-stabilized pump is far lower (~0.02 nm/degC).

parameters.name: Wavelength current-tuning coefficient
parameters.hint: The shift of lasing wavelength with drive current, in m/A (pm/mA or nm/mA normalized: 7 pm/mA is 7e-9 m/A, 1 nm/A is 1e-9 m/A). The fast tuning knob for a current-tuned single-frequency laser; a VBG-stabilized pump is ~0.03 nm/A while a free-running one is ~1 nm/A - the ratio is a real, comparable design figure.

parameters.name: Relative intensity noise (RIN)
parameters.hint: The relative intensity noise of a single-frequency source, in dB - the datasheet prints it as a per-hertz spectral density (dBc/Hz or dB/Hz); keep the unit dB and record the '/Hz' and the offset/bandwidth (and the dBc reference) in conditionsVerbatim, exactly as the ADC's noise-spectral-density keeps dB with the reference in verbatim. A per-hertz dB density is not made a base-SI unit.

parameters.name: Extinction ratio
parameters.hint: The optical power ratio between a logic-one and logic-zero level of a directly-modulated datacom transmitter, in dB (>10 dB typical). Printed on datacom VCSEL/DFB transmitter parts, at a stated data rate and pattern (carry those in conditionsVerbatim).

parameters.name: Beam divergence, parallel to junction
parameters.hint: The far-field beam divergence in the plane parallel to the junction (the slow axis of an edge emitter), in degrees. Record whether it is FWHM or full-angle at 1/e-squared (vendors differ) in conditionsVerbatim. Edge emitters are astigmatic - the parallel angle is smaller than the perpendicular; a VCSEL is symmetric and uses beam_divergence instead.

parameters.name: Beam divergence, perpendicular to junction
parameters.hint: The far-field beam divergence perpendicular to the junction (the fast axis of an edge emitter), in degrees - larger than the parallel angle (e.g. 30 deg vs 11 deg). Record FWHM vs 1/e-squared in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Beam divergence (symmetric)
parameters.hint: The (circularly-symmetric) far-field beam divergence of a VCSEL or the field-of-illumination of a flood illuminator, in degrees - a single value because a VCSEL beam is round, unlike an edge emitter's two orthogonal angles. Record the definition (FWHM, 1/e-squared, D86, 50 %) in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Beam quality M-squared
parameters.hint: The beam quality factor M-squared - a dimensionless number (unit 1), 1.0 for a diffraction-limited (ideal Gaussian) beam and higher for a multimode/high-power emitter. Beam parameter product (mm.mrad), if printed instead, is derivable (BPP = M2 x lambda / pi) and kept in conditionsVerbatim rather than given its own unit.

parameters.name: Astigmatism
parameters.hint: The astigmatic distance between the apparent parallel- and perpendicular-axis source points of an edge emitter, in metres (um normalized: 15 um is 1.5e-5). Matters for collimation optics; a VCSEL has none.

parameters.name: Polarization extinction ratio
parameters.hint: The power ratio between the dominant (usually TE) and orthogonal polarization, in dB (a printed 100:1 ratio is 20 dB). Matters for polarization-sensitive coupling. Store the ratio in dB; keep a printed 'X:1' form in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Numerical aperture (fiber output)
parameters.hint: The numerical aperture of a fiber-coupled module's output fiber - a dimensionless number (unit 1, typically 0.11-0.22). With fiber_core_diameter it sets the beam parameter product of the delivered light.

parameters.name: Fiber core diameter
parameters.hint: The core diameter of a fiber-coupled module's output/pigtail fiber, in metres (um normalized: 105 um is 1.05e-4). A package/output parameter, like an LED's viewing angle - not an intrinsic laser spec, but part of the orderable module.

parameters.name: Fiber-coupled output power
parameters.hint: The optical power delivered out of a fiber-coupled module's pigtail, in watts (mW normalized), after coupling loss - distinct from the chip's optical_output_power. Present only on pigtailed/module parts.

parameters.name: Monitor photodiode current
parameters.hint: The photocurrent of the built-in back-facet monitor photodiode at the rated optical power, in amperes (uA/mA normalized), at a stated monitor reverse bias (attach V_R) - used to servo the laser's output. Array over P_OUT (it tracks optical power). Present only when the package includes a monitor PD (high-power multimode and some blue parts omit it).

parameters.name: Monitor photodiode dark current
parameters.hint: The reverse leakage current of the monitor photodiode with the laser off, in amperes (nA normalized), at a stated reverse bias (attach V_R). Bounds the servo's zero-light offset.

parameters.name: Monitor photodiode capacitance
parameters.hint: The junction capacitance of the monitor photodiode, in farads (pF normalized), at a stated reverse bias and frequency. Sets the servo-loop bandwidth.

parameters.name: Monitor photodiode reverse voltage
parameters.hint: The absolute-maximum reverse voltage of the monitor photodiode (limitClass absolute_max), in volts (typically 20-30 V), distinct from the laser's own reverse_voltage.

parameters.name: Modulation bandwidth
parameters.hint: The small-signal -3 dB optical modulation bandwidth of a datacom laser, in hertz (GHz normalized: 19 GHz is 1.9e10). Distinct from the maximum data_rate it supports.

parameters.name: Maximum data rate
parameters.hint: The maximum signalling rate of a datacom transmitter, in hertz (dimensionally 1/s; a printed Gbit/s or Gbaud is Hz - 25 Gbit/s NRZ is 2.5e10). Keep the printed Gbit/s or Gbaud and the line code (NRZ/PAM4) in conditionsVerbatim; it is related to but distinct from modulation_bandwidth.

parameters.name: Optical rise time
parameters.hint: The 10%-90% (or 20%-80%, per the datasheet) optical rise time, in seconds (ns normalized: 2 ns is 2e-9). Record the percentage points and the O/E-converter bandwidth in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Optical fall time
parameters.hint: The optical fall time, in seconds (ns normalized). Pairs with rise_time for data-rate capability.

parameters.name: Thermal resistance, junction to case
parameters.hint: Junction-to-case thermal resistance, in degC/W (equivalently K/W), a few degC/W for a well-heatsunk power emitter. Sets the junction temperature rise for a given dissipated power.

parameters.name: Junction temperature
parameters.hint: The maximum allowable junction temperature (limitClass absolute_max), in degC. The reliability limit; laser lifetime falls steeply with junction temperature.

parameters.name: Operating (case) temperature range
parameters.hint: The case/ambient temperature range over which the part operates (recommended), in degC. A cooled telecom module derates its case-temperature max relative to its submount setpoint; keep any such relation in conditionsVerbatim. Store min/max bounds.

parameters.name: Storage temperature range
parameters.hint: The non-operating storage temperature range (limitClass absolute_max), in degC. Store min/max bounds.

parameters.name: ESD withstand voltage
parameters.hint: The ESD threshold the part withstands, in volts (kV normalized). Laser facets are ESD-sensitive; some high-power multimode emitters explicitly omit ESD protection (record that, and any built-in protection diode, in conditionsVerbatim). State the model (HBM/CDM/JS-001 class).

parameters.name: TEC (cooler) current
parameters.hint: The maximum current of the integrated thermoelectric cooler (TEC) in a pigtailed/butterfly module (limitClass absolute_max), in amperes. Part of the orderable module (shared MPN), not the laser junction itself - a cooler-subsystem parameter a driver-selection consumer needs to size the TEC controller. The TEC voltage and delta-T go in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Thermistor resistance
parameters.hint: The nominal resistance of the module's integrated NTC thermistor at 25 degC, in ohms (kOhm normalized: 10 kOhm is 10000) - the temperature sense element of the cooling loop. Its %/degC or beta coefficient goes in conditionsVerbatim. A cooler-subsystem parameter, present only on temperature-controlled modules.

parameters.name: Reverse current (laser)
parameters.hint: The absolute-maximum allowable reverse current through the laser junction (limitClass absolute_max), in amperes (mA normalized: 20 mA is 0.02) - distinct from the laser's reverse_voltage rating and from the monitor photodiode's currents. A laser is not built for reverse conduction.

parameters.name: Soldering temperature
parameters.hint: The maximum soldering/lead temperature (limitClass absolute_max), in degC (typically 260), for a stated time and distance from the body - keep those in conditionsVerbatim. Distinct from operating/junction temperature.

parameters.name: Optical (feedback) isolation
parameters.hint: The isolation of a fiber-coupled module's integrated optical isolator against back-reflected light, in dB (typically ~30 dB over a stated wavelength band, kept in conditionsVerbatim). Protects the laser from feedback-induced instability; present only on isolated modules.

parameters.name: Total power dissipation
parameters.hint: The maximum total power the package dissipates (limitClass absolute_max), in watts - the electrical input minus the emitted optical power, all as heat. The led and diode families carry the same key. On a high-power emitter this drives the heatsink design with thermal_resistance_junction_case.

parameters.name: Beam-angle (pointing) deviation
parameters.hint: The guaranteed pointing tolerance of the emitted beam axis relative to the package reference, in degrees (e.g. +/-3 deg, parallel and perpendicular) - a min/typ/max spec on TO-can edge emitters (Thorlabs L-series). A collimation/alignment budget item, distinct from beam_divergence (the beam's own spread) and not a package-outline dimension.

parameters.name: Emission-point positioning accuracy
parameters.hint: The tolerance on the emitter's physical position within the package (delta-X/Y/Z), in metres (um normalized: +/-80 um is 8e-5). What a collimation-optics designer needs to place the focal point. Store the largest +/- bound, or per-axis measurements with the axis in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Number of emitters
parameters.hint: The count of individual emitting apertures in a VCSEL array or an edge-emitter bar - a dimensionless integer (unit 1). A single emitter omits it; a flood-illuminator VCSEL array is hundreds.

parameters.name: Emitter aperture diameter
parameters.hint: The diameter of a VCSEL's (oxide) emitting aperture, in metres (um normalized: 8.5 um is 8.5e-6). Sets the single-emitter power and beam properties.

parameters.name: Wavelength tuning range
parameters.hint: The total (usually mode-hop-free) wavelength span a tunable single-frequency laser reaches via temperature/current tuning, in metres (nm normalized: 2 nm is 2e-9). The achievable SPAN - distinct from the tuning-rate coefficients wavelength_temperature_coefficient and wavelength_current_coefficient.

parameters.name: Kink-free power
parameters.hint: The maximum optical output power before the first kink (a discontinuity from a lateral-mode or filamentation instability) in the light-versus-current curve, in watts - published on high-power single emitters. Distinct from the COD ceiling (a destructive limit); a kink is a usable-power limit.

parameters.name: Thermistor B-constant
parameters.hint: The B (beta) constant of the module's NTC thermistor, in kelvin (e.g. 3900 K, B25/85) - it sets the resistance-vs-temperature law used to read the cooling-loop temperature. Pairs with thermistor_resistance (the 25 degC value).

parameters.name: Fiber cladding diameter
parameters.hint: The cladding diameter of a fiber-coupled module's output fiber, in metres (um normalized: 125 um is 1.25e-4). Printed alongside fiber_core_diameter; a package/output parameter of the orderable module.
